description: For all \(k,e,x,y\in\mathbb N\), \(b(k,e,x)=y+1\) exactly when the resource-bounded evaluator returns \(y\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.UniversalComputation.boundedValue_output (k e x y : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.UniversalComputation.boundedValue k e x = y + 1 ↔
    y ∈ Nat.Partrec.Code.evaln k (Denumerable.ofNat Nat.Partrec.Code e) x
